title: The Dandelion’s Hydraulic Fracturing
core_theme: The slow, vegetative destruction of industrial masonry.
narrative_spec: Analyze a single taproot splitting a five-inch slab of industrial asphalt in an abandoned strip mall parking lot.

title: Hagiography of the Cell Tower Osprey
core_theme: The biological colonization of high-voltage transmission networks.
narrative_spec: Set the poem atop a disguised camouflage pine cell tower where a predatory bird has constructed a nest out of sticks, wire insulation, and discarded plastic packing straps.

title: The Liturgy of the Overflown Storm Drain
core_theme: The sudden reclamation of municipal geography by wild hydrology.
narrative_spec: Document a concrete culvert or storm drain backing up during an unpredicted atmospheric river event.

title: The Creeping Kudzu of the Rail Yard
core_theme: The botanical erasure of obsolete freight infrastructure.
narrative_spec: see if you can trace the erasure of the world around you... be dystopian, and fun and witty.

title: The Pigeon Choir of the Overpass Girder
core_theme: The conversion of structural steel into a communal sanctuary.
narrative_spec: Look upward from a highway shoulder to the hollow steel beams supporting a multi-lane overpass. What else could the steel have supported?

title: The Geometry of the Rust-Bloom
core_theme: The chemical regression of steel back to oxide ore.
narrative_spec: examine the structures we deem historical. What makes tehm so?

title: The Interrogation of the Sidewalk Fig Tree
core_theme: The persistent output of sweetness within an oil-slicked soil matrix.
narrative_spec: A feral fig tree... thats it, do what you want with it.

title: The Blueprint of the Subterranean Termite Mound
core_theme: The structural subversion of building foundations by social insects.
narrative_spec: Follow the path of a colony of wood-devouring insects moving upward through the microscopic settling cracks of a concrete basement floor. Treat their mud tubes as an alternative, stigmergic architecture that slowly hollows out the structural timber of the property, rewriting the human home into an insect kingdom.

title: The Litany of the Intermittent Puddle Ecosystem
core_theme: The microscopic generation of life within temporary asphalt depressions.
narrative_spec: What do you think about the seasonal allergies?

title: The Dialectics of the Sub-Asphalt Night-Crawler
core_theme: The subterranean lung of the city working during rain.
narrative_spec: can you tap in to the blind biological calling of specific creatures?

title: The Last Sump-Pump Anthem
core_theme: The technological exhaustion of keeping the water table out.
narrative_spec: think of the brain power required to keep metropolises moving... does this move you or disgust you... or something else?
